Airtable operates as a relational database tool equipped with extensive work management features and its embedded AI assistant, Omni.

The platform supports multiple views including Grid, Kanban, Gantt, and Calendar, alongside multi-factor authentication across all tiers.

It provides four subscription plans: Free, Team, Business, and Enterprise Scale, with varying AI credit allocations per editor.
